query:
SELECT a.id as "id!",
                  COALESCE(SUM(te.minutes), 0)::int as "total!"
           FROM approvals a
           LEFT JOIN time_entries te
             ON te.user_id = a.user_id
            AND te.org_id = a.org_id
            AND te.spent_date BETWEEN a.period_start AND a.period_end
           WHERE a.id = ANY($1) AND a.org_id = $2
           GROUP BY a.id
